license.original_perturb_seq_data_license: CC-BY-4.0 as declared by pinned CausalBench README External data section
license.rights_boundary: No full raw dataset redistributed. An institutional mirror and matching filename do not establish byte equality to benchmark input.

actual_data.benchmark_identity_limit: RPE1 filename/source family matches; exact equivalence to Figshare file35775606 not verified.

original_benchmark_inputs.loader_limitation: CreateDataset.load downloads and preprocesses both K562 and RPE1 even for a single requested dataset. Do not budget only the8.7GB RPE1 mirror.

strong_complete_baseline_source.method: PSGRN (one strong published comparator, not proof of globally strongest method)
strong_complete_baseline_source.license: MIT; upstream causalscbench subtree retains Apache-2.0 notices
strong_complete_baseline_source.launcher: run.sh invokes src/main_fast.py and matched GRNBoost baseline
strong_complete_baseline_source.reason: Required LightGBM, Scanpy/AnnData, Arboreto, HDF5 and benchmark package missing; complete harness also depends on unavailable Torch and other packages. Source availability is not runtime qualification.
known_controls_required: BetterBoost or another independently justified strongest complete alternative

cheapest_discriminating_next_step.purpose: Qualify exact-data loading and run the intact published PSGRN versus competent controls before claiming a residual failure.
sequence: Provision isolated upstream-compatible environment (README Python3.10 path versus supplied environment.yml Python3.8 disagreement must be resolved/tested). Do not install into frozen core runtime.

Stage the exact Figshare RPE1+K562 inputs using a working authorized route; verify full hashes and cell/gene/intervention metadata. If using institutional mirror, explicitly register and test equivalence first.
Run upstream command below on the whole declared cohort; preserve seed, intervention split, all failures and resource costs. No synthetic/observational substitute is admissible.
cheapest_discriminating_next_step.upstream_runtime_command: python causalscbench/apps/main_app.py --dataset_name weissmann_rpe1 --output_directory /tmp/alpha-causalbench-next/output --exp_id psgrn-rpe1-025-seed0 --data_directory /tmp/alpha-causalbench-next/data --training_regime partial_interventional --partial_intervention_seed 0 --fraction_partial_intervention 0.25 --model_name custom --inference_function_file_path ./src/main_fast.py --subset_data 1.0 --model_seed 0 --omission_estimation_size 2000 --do_filter
cheapest_discriminating_next_step.environment: PYTHONPATH=. in isolated environment qualified against pinned README and environment.yml; installing source alone is insufficient.
cheapest_discriminating_next_step.storage_note: Both original benchmark files, preprocessing caches and dense matrices must be measured; minimum known single-file size already exceeds100MB suballocation.
cheapest_discriminating_next_step.useful_endpoint: Held-out-intervention causal-network performance plus full data/preprocessing/training/checking resources; no baseline deficit or useful advantage measured in this access probe.

accounting.note: Dependency/source/access probes only; package installation and full baseline omitted at actual data/runtime boundary.
